edges.reason: Constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender, making the caller the initial holder.
msg.sender is propagated through transfer/transferFrom into _transfer as the from address.
Owner is derived from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor and gates privileged functions.
tx.origin is used as the mapping key for the per-block transfer delay throttle.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making execution depend on miner-controllable time.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
_transfer invokes swapBack which performs external ETH transfers, enabling reentrancy paths.
Blacklist mapping is read to gate from/to addresses before any transfer.
Fee exclusion mapping determines whether fees are charged and whether swaps can occur.
Max transaction exclusion mapping bypasses limit checks for privileged accounts.
AMM pair mapping decides buy/sell fee and limit branches.
limitsInEffect flag guards the anti-whale enforcement block.
transferDelayEnabled flag guards the per-block purchase throttle.
tradingActive flag blocks non-excluded transfers until trading is enabled.
swapping flag acts as a guard around swapBack to limit nested swaps.
swapTokensAtAmount threshold decides whether swapBack is triggered.
maxTransactionAmount limits the size of buys and sells.
maxWallet caps the recipient balance after a transfer.
_transfer writes the tx.origin keyed last-transfer record to enforce one buy per block.
_transfer performs fee multiplication, division and amount -= fees arithmetic.
The amount parameter flows into the fee computation and subtraction.
_transfer mutates the balance ledger for sender, recipient and the contract.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to ukraineWallet, an external callable target.
swapBack forwards the entire ETH balance to marketingWallet via a low-level call.
The call target is the mutable ukraineWallet state address, so a changed wallet controls reentry.
The call target is the mutable marketingWallet state address.
swapBack delegates the token-to-ETH swap to swapTokensForEth.
swapBack calls addLiquidity to pair tokens with the accumulated ETH.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForMarketing when computing ETH shares.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForLiquidity to size the liquidity half.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForUkraine when computing ETH shares.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call with zero minimum output.
The router state variable supplies the swap target and WETH address.
addLiquidity performs an external payable router addLiquidityETH call with zero minimums.
The router state variable is the liquidity call target.
Constructor assigns the immutable uniswapV2Router reference.
Constructor creates and assigns the immutable uniswapV2Pair reference.
Constructor mints the total supply into the _balances ledger.
Constructor sets the total supply through _mint.
Ownable constructor stored msg.sender as _owner during deployment.
Constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, contract and dead address.
Owner-only updateMarketingWallet rewrites the ETH payout destination.
Owner-only updateUkraineWallet rewrites the ETH payout destination.
Owner-only updateBuyFees rewrites the aggregated buy fee.
Owner-only updateSellFees rewrites the aggregated sell fee.
Owner-only addToBlacklist writes blacklist entries that block transfers.
Owner-only excludeFromFees writes the fee exemption mapping.
Owner-only excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the limit exemption mapping.
Owner-only enableTrading flips tradingActive to true.
Owner-only enableTrading flips swapEnabled to true.
Owner-only removeLimits disables the anti-whale limit checks.
owner() returns the stored _owner state variable.
Owner-only updateSwapTokensAtAmount rewrites the swap trigger threshold.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter is used only inside _transfer for blacklist, limit and fee-branch decisions.
The to parameter shapes AMM/fee branches and max wallet validation only within _transfer.
The amount parameter feeds limit checks and the fee arithmetic performed in _transfer.
tokenAmount is consumed solely by the swap helper call.
ethAmount is consumed solely by the payable addLiquidityETH call.
newWallet is assigned directly to the ukraineWallet state variable inside the setter.
newMarketingWallet is assigned directly to the marketingWallet state variable inside the setter.
The addresses array is iterated only to populate the blacklist mapping.
newAmount is bounded then assigned to swapTokensAtAmount.
fees is a temporary accumulator that is subtracted from the transfer amount.
contractBalance is the local balance snapshot driving the swap sizing.
totalTokensToSwap aggregates the three token accounting counters for share math.
liquidityTokens is derived and consumed only inside swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is computed in swapBack and forwarded to the swap helper.
ethBalance is the post-swap ETH delta split between payouts and liquidity.
success only captures the return value of the low-level ETH transfer calls.
